evidence.uncertainty: Existing Compose already runs local PostgreSQL/pgvector and MinIO, while backend/frontend container contracts and least-privilege MinIO bootstrap must be defined.
evidence.scope: The change spans Compose orchestration, backend/frontend image builds, migration ordering, MinIO access policy, ignored local credentials, and documentation.
evidence.reasoning: Browser API routing, startup preflight, Alembic migrations, health ordering, persistent volumes, and MinIO application credentials must align without copying secrets into images.
evidence.verification: Compose validation, image builds, container health, migration inspection, and a fictional-sample end-to-end workflow require live Docker infrastructure.
